_meta.title: Backroom A+B retained cruising candidate audit — positions 41–45
_meta.method: Preserved original-directory and per-batch source evidence cross-checked with official operators, public independent geographies and recent posts where obtainable. Eight-source archive alignment is not an exhaustive new login-protected live check.
_meta.uncertainty: Anonymous user claims are reports, not independently verified sexual activity. Mapping physical building ≠ identifying exact claimed cruising location. No site modifications authorized.

records.name: Parking Murcki
records.place: Cruising original refers to parking behind the MOL fuel station, on the right heading toward Mysłowice–Stara Wesoła. Current saved station reference 'ul. Pawła Kołodzieja 86' and coordinates 50.198095096355,19.052733061481 come from third-party myLPG database. MOL's own published station list instead specifies address UL. PAWŁA KOŁODZIEJA 10 and station GPS 50.1977997,19.0519009. A Katowice municipal January 2026 trade permit directory also identifies MOL-operated fuel-station shop at Kołodzieja 10 (PDF screenshot not retrievable, online extracted text consistent), and property record corroborates 10. THIS IS A MATERIAL DIFFERENCE. Operator-derived reference is more authoritative. Exact parking bay behind station remains unpinned.

activity.note: Poster says on-site and seeks company; not evidence of an actual completed sexual encounter.

records.access: Petrol station trading area, busy traffic and adjoining land with potentially restricted access. Don't publish a claimed exact car park behind it unless verified in original directions.
records.duplicates: Not proven same as another Katowice Murcki forest/carpark lead in archive; do not merge merely by nearby access road.
corrections: Use MOL operator verified site address Kołodzieja 10, not third-party 86, for a future owner-approved general-station landmark update.
Use operator GPS as station reference (50.1977997,19.0519009) rather than third-party 50.198095096355,19.052733061481; clarify NOT a cruising car park pin.
Do not present 2026 stated presence as firsthand completed sexual activity.

records.name: Aquadrom Pool
records.place: Aquadrom multi-zone public water park at ul. Kłodnicka 95A, Ruda Śląska-Halemba, NOT Katowice. Original cruising account refers to steam sauna; current generic aquatic centre coordinates 50.2418,18.8439 are reasonable for building, not specific steam sauna.

activity.note: Reports previous day's sauna visit as good; uncorroborated.
Visitor 10–12 found little happening; one visit only.
A source poster says he generally sees men; no independent confirmation.

records.access: Official operator differentiates recreation/sport from Saunarium. Pools Mon–Fri 10:00–22:00, weekends/holidays 09:00–22:00. Saunarium Mon–Wed 12:00–22:00, Thu–Fri 10:00–22:00, weekends/holidays 09:00–22:00. Paid family-oriented aquatic centre with adult sauna section, not an authorised gay sex sauna.
records.duplicates: Do not classify general aqua park as separate from its sauna in this original source; no separate documented gay-venue duplicate.
corrections: IMPORTANT: Existing description says entire operator 10–22 weekdays / 09–22 weekends. Because original report specifically concerns saunarium, state distinct Mon–Wed sauna opening from 12:00 rather than implying steam sauna accessible at 10:00.
Preserve opposing June2026 reports without crowd/busyness conclusions.

activity.note: Digital check-in metadata; physical presence and activity not verified.

records.duplicates: No matching uniquely named side-road candidate established; no merge.
corrections: Use an ordinary broad Shell Świecko landmark query for future approved publication, not exact fake driveway.
Current data describes side road as unlocated and should retain that limitation.
No legitimate 2026 sexual activity confirmation from a platform check-in.

records.name: The Warsaw HUB
records.place: Warsaw HUB multiuse office/retail/hotel complex at Rondo Daszyńskiego 2B/2C. Operator official directions place nearby Rondo Daszyńskiego M2 around 200 m from building and paid parking on level -1. That parking is NOT proven source cruising spot. Exact floor/retail bathroom alleged by original anonymous entry cannot be recovered.

activity.note: Question whether anyone there; no on-site sex or completed meeting.

records.access: Separate offices, hotel, shops and commercial parking with different security and access rules. General building hours and parking operator don't establish public availability of unlocated WC.
records.duplicates: Not connected to Warsaw Olympic Centre or other city parking lead; no exact duplicate evidence.
corrections: Important avoid falsely associating verified -1 paid garage with original anonymous cruising location.
Relevance is a recent source-site question, not actual activity; description currently cautious.
No authorisation for public restroom or private offices.

records.name: Olimpic Centre
records.place: Original source says bushes and woodland on the Vistula river bank near Olympic Centre, Wybrzeże Gdyńskie 4; location is RIVERSIDE LAND, not Olympic Committee building interior. Saved 52.2741,20.99688 is broad landmark point. Exact riverside trails and their access remain unverified.

activity.note: Forum writer alleged an intoxicated person with a large knife threatened visitors; serious allegation not independently corroborated.

records.access: Public riverside paths may be usable but centre building rules are separate; source warns of personal safety concern. No basis for declaring this area safe or actively cruised from website rank/check-in data.
records.duplicates: Original source lists nearby 'Lasek od ścieżki w LEWO' about 0.1 km away; POTENTIAL OVERLAP worth comparing map pins. Do not auto-merge merely because very close. Source also lists generic Parking 0.6km away.
corrections: Retain June 26 serious safety incident with correct attribution as uncorroborated user report, rather than claiming confirmed recent crime.
Nearby source listing 'Lasek od ścieżki w LEWO' at 0.1 km suggests possible same forest area. Needs source-pin comparison as later duplication QA.
Do not claim precise meeting paths are identified.
